tools.name: get_calendar_settings
tools.description: Reads and parses the XML file structurally. Returns modeled settings (view, display_event_types, internal_storage_path) along with all raw key-value pairs in all_settings. Returns an empty settings object if the file does not exist or is unreadable.

view.description: The active calendar view setting (e.g., daily, weekly, monthly representation value).

display_event_types.description: Comma-separated list or encoded string of event type IDs to display.

internal_storage_path.description: Configured internal storage path for exports/backups.

all_settings.description: Raw key-value pairs parsed from Prefs.xml for unmodeled settings.

tools.name: set_calendar_setting
tools.description: Modifies or inserts the specified key-value pair matching the designated value_type tag. Preserves all other unknown keys and maintains correct file permissions. Stops the app process before writing to avoid conflicts with cached values.

value.description: The value to set, serialized as a string.

value_type.description: The data type of the preference value.
